text:
jordan: quick follow-up from the aggregator/etl correctness alert last night. want to capture owners + next steps here.

maya: thanks. root cause looked like two things: 1) duplicate partial batches in the ETL window causing over-counts, 2) a sampling change in spans client that dropped certain span types. recurring pattern for long-tail customers.

liam: i can take the ETL dedup fix. plan: add a deterministic dedupe key and a sliding-window commit check so partial batches don't double-apply. ETA 72 hours.

olivia: i'll own the backfill plan for affected aggregation keys (customer_id + hour). i'll coordinate a safe window and throttled job run. target: 1 week to complete on prod data.

anil: i'll dig into the spans client change — looks like the new sampler default was flipped in 2.3.0. i'll pin client to 2.2.x for now and draft a compatibility test.

qa-elena: i'll prepare a small acceptance dataset (1k traces) to validate both fixes before we run backfill. will run regression tests against metrics dashboard.

jordan: nice. can each owner add a short runbook fragment to the postmortem doc with steps + rollback? we need clear runbook for recurring pattern.

liam: yes. adding a snippet here for the dedupe step:
```sql
-- dedupe by event_id + window_start, keep first commit_id
with ranked as (
  select *, row_number() over(partition by event_id, window_start order by commit_id) rn
  from raw_events
)
insert into agg_events
select * from ranked where rn = 1;
```
liam: i'm also adding the commit-check hook: if commit_id already applied -> noop.

olivia: backfill plan (high level): 1) run dry-run on staging -> compare counts 2) run throttled backfill in prod during low-traffic window 3) monitor per-customer diffs and alert if >5% delta. i'll put exact steps in the doc.

anil: instrumentation fix: revert sampler default in client, then add explicit sampler config in SDK boot. will create PR and request prod patch.

maya: timeline summary: dedupe patch (liam) — 72h, sampler revert (anil) — 24h + hotfix deploy, backfill (olivia) — 7d, validation (qa-elena) — before backfill.

jordan: assigning owners in tracker: liam (ETL dedupe), anil (span sampler), olivia (backfill), qa-elena (validation). i'll own coordination and postmortem doc updates.

sre-bot: incident-20493 opened: https://incidents.internal/20493 • severity: P2 • linked postmortem: doc/20493-postmortem • auto-created runbook: /runbooks/aggregator-dup

liam: one question — do we want to add a permanent check in the nightly monitor to compare hourly aggregates vs streaming aggregates and alert on drift?

maya: yes please. add alert with 10% threshold and a weekly trend check. triage team should own initial paging.

qa-elena: i'll add the validation tests to CI and a synthetic trace generator to make the edge cases reproducible.

jordan: ok. final asks: everyone paste a short 2-3 line status update here when their PR/backfill dry-run is done. we'll review in ops standup tomorrow at 11:00. thanks all :thumbsup:

olivia: noted. will post dry-run results here. :eyes:

anil: PR opened -> https://git.internal/repo/pulls/421. marking as in-progress.

liam: dedupe branch pushed, tests passing locally, creating PR now.

qa-elena: staging validation finished — small diff found in customer 8721, will detail in comment thread.

jordan: perfect. leaving this thread pinned to the incident. if anything urgent, ping @oncall.

maya: great coordination. adding this as an action to the monthly reliability checklist so recurring pattern gets periodic review. :white_check_mark:
